purpose: Configuration reference for portable Python operations. This is documentation, not a runtime configuration file.
configuration_rules: Required values must be explicitly supplied and nonblank before credentials, network access or writes.
Standard public Microsoft API endpoints and first-party resource application IDs are protocol constants, not tenant configuration.
No .env file is loaded automatically by these entrypoints; export the required environment explicitly.
No cloud validation was performed. Offline tests use fake identities and mocked service clients.
The frontend owns display branding. Neither operations nor the BFF needs a bank-name environment variable.
The offline --local-smoke action on agent\create_agent.py requires no environment variables.

agent_explicit.notes: Managed identity requires an explicitly selected user-assigned identity. No credential chain.

azure_cli_tenant.notes: Existing Azure CLI authentication is bound to the explicitly configured tenant.

workiq_cli_tenant.notes: Existing Azure CLI authentication is bound to the explicitly configured tenant.

workiq_seeder.notes: seed_work_iq.py defaults to app auth, never falls back; seed_mission_mail.py uses app auth only. No client or tenant identity defaults.

fabric_notebook.notes: The authenticated Fabric notebook runtime supplies service access; its context must match the explicitly configured workspace and lakehouse.

workiq_audit.notes: Application authentication, with no fallback or preset user/team scope. Audit terms are explicit literal terms in a nonempty JSON array.

workiq_device.notes: Explicit delegated device authentication; no client secret or preset application identity.

data\\work-iq\\seed_work_iq.py.notes: The mapping must explicitly contain an account UPN for every used persona alias. Map-users also requires displayName, jobTitle, department and distinct accounts. Without --onedrive-alias, files target SharePoint only.

data\\fabric-iq\\deploy_fabric.py.notes: A full deployment requires all step settings. --status needs only base settings. The deployer injects validated notebook settings and discovered workspace/lakehouse IDs.

data\\foundry-iq\\index_cm_policies.py.notes: The same search settings must be supplied to the agent's hybrid policy tool. --verify performs retrieval checks only.

agent\\create_agent.py.notes: IQ_MODE must be local or hybrid. Both use the explicit synthetic Work/Fabric corpus; hybrid additionally uses live Search/Bing. CM_CLIENT_ID must exist in clients.csv. --local-smoke bypasses all cloud configuration.

agent\\create_cm_agents.py.notes: Target agent names and instructions are explicitly declared by the adjacent cm_agents.md specification; the source must not be a target.

create_scenario_agent.py.notes: Source and target agent names must differ.

app\\infra\\configure_rbac.py.notes: INFRA_ROLE_ASSIGNMENTS is a nonempty JSON object mapping explicit full UPNs to defined application role names.

conditional.when: adding redirects to an existing app

triage_mailboxes.py.notes: WORKIQ_MAIL_SOURCE_FILES is a nonempty JSON array of reviewed local corpus paths, resolved from cwd. Default is report-only; --purge performs moves only after complete inventory.

preflight.py.notes: Default source-only run never authenticates. Needs Python, Node.js and installed frontend dependencies. A source pass is not tenant policy or permission approval.

app\\src\\bff.notes: MOCK_MODE=true is explicit offline behavior, not a fallback on errors. Omitted optional live integrations are unavailable, never fabricated. ALLOW_APP_IDENTITY_FALLBACK is compatibility-only and does not enable delegated-agent fallback. Set AAD_API_SCOPE consistently with the frontend app registration when used.

private_mapping_rule: Copy the template to an ignored private JSON file and replace every example.com UPN. Set WORKIQ_USER_MAPPING_FILE explicitly. Original user_mapping.json and user_mapping.restore.json are untracked but preserved locally.
publishing_ignore_contract: generated bank configuration and logo files

azure_cli_auth: Azure CLI with an existing session in the explicitly configured tenant
offline_tests: Python standard library unittest for operations; BFF tests additionally need app\src\bff\requirements.txt
